immigration.headline: USCIS Assists Florida Investigation Leading to Charges for Unlawful Voting
immigration.body: U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services provided critical assistance to investigations that resulted in charges against 16 aliens accused of unlawfully voting in Florida elections.

immigration.headline: Cuban Alien Convicted for International Alien Smuggling and Money Laundering Conspiracy
immigration.body: U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services played a critical role in the investigation that led to the conviction of Lazaro Alain Cabrera-Rodriguez, 28, of Hialeah, Florida, for his role in an international alien smuggling and money laundering conspiracy.

immigration.headline: Aliens Charged with Illegally Voting and Making False Statements While Applying for US Citizenship
immigration.body: An Essex County man and a Middlesex County woman, both aliens, were charged with illegally voting in a federal election and making false statements while applying for U.S. citizenship.

immigration.headline: Nigerian Alien Indicted for Illegally Voting
immigration.body: A federal grand jury in Topeka returned an indictment charging a Nigerian alien with falsely claiming to be a U.S. citizen to illegally vote in elections.

immigration.headline: Romanian Alien Admits Conspiring to Commit Marriage Fraud
immigration.body: A Romanian alien admitted to conspiring with an American citizen to enter into a sham marriage so that she could obtain U.S. citizenship. U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services assisted the investigation.
